messages:
Priya: Heads-up — need to finalize RFC review slots for Wed eng sync. We have three slots (nominal): 10:00, 10:20, 10:40. Please reply with author/reviewer + preferred slot. Pre-read doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/rfc-queue (add a 1‑line summary under 'meeting-summary').

Jonah: I can review slot 1 (10:00). Will post comments by EOD today :+1:

Mika: I'm the author for the "dynamic routing" RFC — prefer slot 2 (10:20). @Jonah would you be OK as primary reviewer? :raising_hand:

Priya: Slot 2 noted for Mika. @Alex can you take slot 3? Quick reminder for authors: add a short summary + 3 acceptance criteria in the RFC doc. Easiest place is the bottom — add under `meeting-summary`.

Alex: Yep, I can do slot 3. Quick Q — do we want to keep 20m per slot? We ran long last time. Suggest 15m + 5m actions.

Sienna: 15m + 5m sounds good. Also can we reorder so the infra-ish RFC goes first? It affects the others.

Devon: Infra RFC (I'm co-author) will probably need more than 15m. Options: (a) do a 30m deep-dive outside the sync, or (b) run a focused 15m overview here and follow up. I'm fine either way.

Priya: Proposed agenda then: 10:00 — Infra (15m overview), 10:15 — Dynamic routing (15m), 10:30 — Dedicated capacity docs (15m). If infra needs follow-up we'll spin a separate deep-dive. I'll update the calendar.

eng-bot: Calendar event created: "Eng RFC Review — Wed" — 2026-03-20 10:00–10:45. Invitees: @eng, @infra. Link: https://calendar.internal/event/abc123

Jonah: I'll do pre-read + leave inline comments. Also can someone add an explicit "rollback/fallback" section to the routing RFC? helps reviewers.

Mika: Added the rollback bullets:
```
- fallback to model-v1
- route 5% to warm nodes then increase
- telemetry hooks to monitor latency/regressions
```

Priya: Thanks — checklist for authors before Wed: (1) add meeting-summary, (2) add acceptance criteria, (3) tag reviewers in the doc, (4) attach diagrams where relevant. I'll ping again tomorrow for final confirmations.

Sienna: One last thing — can we record the sync? Need it for team members in APAC who can't make it.

Priya: Yes, will record and upload to the eng drive. See you all tomorrow.
